text_excerpt: ICT And E-Library Unit - IFEDAYO OLADAPO LIBRARY Skip to content IFEDAYO OLADAPO LIBRARY Home About Us The University Librarian Departments Acquisition Unit EKSU Law Library Faculty of Education Faculty of Science Library Medical Library Readers’ Services Department Technical Services Department ICT And E-Library Unit The Faculty of Multidisciplinary Studies Library E-Resources LIBRARY RULES AND REGULATIONS Hamburger Toggle Menu ICT And E-Library Unit Welcome to the digital heart of the Ifedayo Oladapo Library. As the institution’s hub for digital transformation, we provide the high-performance infrastructure and innovative tools essential for 21st-century academic excellence. Our Core Services Connectivity and Network Infrastructure In collaboration with the Directorate of ICT, we manage the library’s Local Area Network (LAN) and campus-wide Wi-Fi to ensure high-speed, low-latency access for research and global collaboration. Scholarly Resource Architecture Explore our sophisticated digital repositories, featuring global e-journals, multidisciplinary databases, and archived institutional research data. Digital Systems and Web Governance The unit maintain the Koha Integrated Library System (ILS) and administrative portals to ensure that academic and administrative workflows remain seamless. Capacity Building & Digital Literacy Sharpen researchers’ search skills through our specialised training sessions on information discovery, digital tool mastery, and essential ICT literacy. Digitization & Process Automation We drive the transition from physical to digital formats through large-scale digitisation projects and automated library operations for faster, more accurate data retrieval. Cyber-Resilience & Data Stewardship The unit safeguards your research by implementing rigorous security protocols and ethical data management frameworks to protect institutional intellectual property. Technical Support & Systems Maintenance Our team provides proactive oversight for all ICT assets, from hardware configuration and software optimisation to comprehensive technical troubleshooting. Our Commitment The ICT/E-Library Services Unit is dedicated to pioneering secure, scalable, and user-centric digital solutions that bridge the gap between traditional scholarship and the evolving global knowledge economy.
